name: 男士套头连帽卫衣基础款
description: 连帽抽绳加前置大口袋，套头版型通勤日常都好搭

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless off-white #FFFFFF packshot field, warm sand #EFE7DB lifestyle wall, ink charcoal #2E2C29 graphic panel, one sage accent #8FA394
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio light, large front-left key with bounce fill on the shadow side, gentle contact shadows, one consistent light direction across the set
styleLock.surfaceSystem: polished concrete floor #C7C1B8 and a low warm timber bench #C89B6A for lifestyle frames, seamless paper for packshots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, narrow left-aligned benefit column, all source wording replaced by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in sage #8FA394 only, no filled or three-dimensional icons
styleLock.presentationRules: on-body styling always cropped at the neck so no face appears, stable slight 3/4 garment turn and consistent garment scale across every frame
noDrift: no visible model faces or identities
no invented fabric specs, weights or certifications
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimal menswear outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless off-white #FFFFFF, warm sand #EFE7DB, ink charcoal #2E2C29 and one sage accent #8FA394; neutral soft diffused studio lighting with a large front-left key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows; polished concrete and warm timber surfaces in lifestyle frames; modern geometric sans-serif with a narrow left-aligned benefit column; thin single-weight line icons; on-body garment styling cropped at the neck with a stable slight 3/4 turn and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible model faces.

shots.displayName: 白底套头卫衣正面主图

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large front-left softbox with a bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce outerwear hero photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Negative: no face, no model identity, no text, no graphics, no watermark, no fake logo, no props, no cropped cuffs or hem, no grey or gradient background.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底男模正面上身，手插前置大口袋、抽绳孔眼与罗纹袖口可见；002 白底后侧 45 度背面，双层连帽自然摊开；003 暖色影棚全身，同色系束口裤、深色提包与小白鞋；004 帽口抽绳孔眼与袖口罗纹特写，手指与下颌入镜；005 白底全身正面，牛仔裤与短靴；006 白底全身，另一身形模特着同款配紧身裤与运动鞋，属同一件跨身形展示；007 木质更衣室坐姿场景，左侧叠排四行英文卖点文案；008 逆光树叶与蓝天的品牌环保故事卡，含字标与标语。品类判定：源提示为卫衣与上衣，图为套头连帽保暖外衣、以外穿层叠为主，故改判为男装 L2 外套（表内逐字命中），productFamily 取 fashion。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列标识、环保故事标语与英文标语原句、007 四行卖点原句、001/002/003/005/006/007 全部模特面容与身份、平台角标与社会证明；面料成分、克重、尺码与洗涤等事实数值一律未写入，改用空白印章框、空白参数行与图内文案占位符承载；无儿童出镜，无竞品对照。
